statement_summary: One CSF 2.0 program meeting every division's regulatory programs
Group CISO accountable; division leads, FedRAMP senior security official, Qualified Individual, HIPAA Security Official designated
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; no acceptance of High risks to federal data, CUI, cardholder data, or banks' covered services
regulatory_driver: C-IT-R01; N54-R05; PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12

statement_summary: Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance annually for regulated scopes
Sanctions documented by HR
Intercompany services governed as service provider relationships with agreements, responsibility matrices, and annual assessment
Vendor tiering; 24-hour incident notice for tier 1; covered-person screening
Annual internal assessment plus FedRAMP, PCI DSS, and CMMC assessments
Retain security documentation at least 6 years
AI systems registered and approved; no automated actions in G1, the CDE, or the enclave without owner approval
Tooling that acts on many systems reaches regulated environments only with owner approval and inside documented scope
Unique SYS-G1 identities; legacy tenants migrated by 2027-03-31; no new federation trusts without approval
Least privilege; cross-division access scoped per client and approved by the owning division
MFA for all; phishing-resistant for all privileged, partner-operator, and RMM access by 2026-12-31
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM; no standing privileged access
Privileged and partner-operator sessions end after 1 hour with device-bound tokens
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination; contractor expiry
Quarterly certification including privileged, service, partner-operator, and RMM accounts
Break-glass accounts per critical system tested quarterly
Remote access through the broker; RMM named accounts, location limits, and two-person approval for multi-client or regulated jobs
MFA for customer administrators, merchant users, and consumer payee changes
Workload identities; 90-day rotation; no credentials in tickets or notes
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Record discovery and each clock-starting determination per notifying entity
Each notifying entity owns its notices
Matrix maintained by counsel; no legal review delays a regulatory clock
Disclosure committee within 24 hours of Severity 1; 8-K within 4 business days of determination
Ransom payments need board approval and an OFAC check
Annual cross-division exercise with the matrix, a PAIN rating, and a materiality decision
Evidence preservation; 90-day image preservation for covered defense information
Automated containment only for approved action classes; analyst approval in G1, the CDE, and the enclave
Incident commander may stop RMM, run-command, partner-operator access, and fleet automation group-wide
Classification scheme with regulated data in Restricted
Encryption with group keys; FIPS 140 validated modules for G1 data and CUI, documented
Federal data stays in G1, CUI in the enclave, cardholder data in the CDE
Logs and alert context minimized; no G1 identifiers, CUI, or account data to out-of-scope services
Immutable backups at external provider X; quarterly restore tests for High systems
Retention schedule; consumer information disposed within 2 years after last use
Annual awareness training including adversary-in-the-middle phishing; quarterly phishing exercises
Role-based training before privileged, partner-operator, RMM, enclave, or CDE access
Approved generative AI tools only; no regulated data in unapproved tools
